all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The Administration announced a public spending part of the economic stimulus programme, appropriating funds totaling $20.1 billion for various initiatives including public service jobs and local public works.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: The funding is aimed at stimulating economic activity and job creation, which supports overall growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The reform has been enacted and is currently in force.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The reform represents a significant allocation of public funds for economic stimulus.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: $20.1 billion, included: (0) $7.9 billion for public service jobs; (ii) $4 billion for local public works; (iii) $1.4 billion for employment and training programmes.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: A tax-cut bill was enacted, reducing taxes by $2.6 billion in FY 1977 and $17.8 billion in FY 1978, including a tax credit for employers hiring new workers.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: The tax cuts are designed to incentivize hiring and investment, which can enhance economic growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The tax-cut bill has been enacted and is currently in force.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The reform represents a major change in tax policy aimed at stimulating economic activity.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: Tax-cut bill enacted, reducing taxes by $2.6 billion in FY 1977 and $17.8 billion in FY 1978.
